item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Scholz used nuclear capability to shield conventional aggression, territorial coercion, or domestic repression. The evidence base is mostly about avoiding entanglement and using conventional deterrence defensively. Because Germany does not possess an independent nuclear arsenal, the relevant record is largely indirect and alliance-based rather than about direct national nuclear use.","evidence":[{"title":"Scholz: Nichtbeteiligung deutscher Soldaten sicherstellen","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"13 Mar 2024","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw11-de-regierungsbefragung-991060","summary":"Scholz said he would not approve long-range systems if German soldiers had to be involved outside Ukraine, because he wanted to ensure no German participation in the war. This is strong evidence that he avoided using military capability in a way that could shield or enable territorial coercion.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.1"]},{"title":"The Federal Chancellor’s 2024 summer press conference “I look forward to your questions”","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"24 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040","summary":"Scholz said U.S. medium-range weapons would be stationed in Germany to protect Germany and NATO states against attack and to prevent war, and tied the decision to Russia’s violations of arms-control agreements. This is defensive deterrence, not nuclear shielding of aggression.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.4","1B.1"]},{"title":"Federal Chancellor Scholz’ press conference at the NATO Summit","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"11 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/pc-chancellor-nato-summit-2298906","summary":"Scholz defended the stationing of U.S. conventional weapons as part of deterrence and defense. The page also notes the NATO command in Wiesbaden will coordinate support for Ukraine. This supports a reading of restraint and alliance defense rather than coercive nuclear cover.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.4","1B.1"]},{"title":"Stationierung ab 2026 Scholz verteidigt US-\"Tomahawks\" in Deutschland","publisher":"tagesschau.de","date":"11 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/scholz-marschflugkoerper-stationierung-100.html","summary":"Scholz framed the deployment under the NATO nuclear umbrella and as necessary for deterrence. Critics warned of an arms race and escalation risk. This is the strongest borderline item, but it is still not evidence that Scholz used nuclear capability to cover aggression or repression.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.4"]}]}
